description: Establish the working baseline and capture the current failure precisely, so the fidelity/architecture rework in FEAT-002 has a measured before/after and cannot silently regress the 100%-text conversion path. This feature makes NO source changes to rendering; it only sets up and records numbers. Depends on nothing; blocks FEAT-002.
steps: Activate the environment: `. .venv/bin/activate` (the venv at /projects/sandbox/mussannoni/.venv already has the project + dev deps installed with python 3.11.15; recreate only if missing with `~/.pyenv/versions/3.11.15/bin/python -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -e '.[dev]'`). Then `sars unpack` to populate data/sars from the committed sars.zip.

Record BASELINE numbers in this feature's findings by running: `sars all 2>&1 | tail -2` (expect `19/19 documents pass; mean text similarity 100.00%`), `python tools/template_audit.py 2>&1 | tail -5` (record the full summary line), and `pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -5` (record pass count).

Regenerate the current data + templated output so a like-for-like before/after is possible: `sars data` then `sars template`, then `python tools/compare.py --template` (writes output/compare/TEMPLATE *.jpg). Do NOT commit these regenerations as a separate change - they are the 'before' reference for FEAT-003; note in findings that they reflect the OLD shared-CSS look.

Confirm the data carriers FEAT-002 will consume are present and rich: run a quick python snippet loading output/data/'MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK.json' and report (a) the distinct non-null per-cell `background` colours across rows/summary/totals, (b) an example row `pitch` value, (c) that per-cell `styles` carry family/size_pt/align/rotation. Record the findings (this proves the fidelity gap is in RENDERING, not extraction).

Record in findings the exact list of shared-CSS / shared-chrome coupling points that FEAT-002 must dismantle, by grepping the source: every reference to `DOC_CSS`, `TEMPLATE_CSS`, `styles.css`, `document_html`, and the `TemplatePool`/`StylePool` usage across src/sars/templates/*.py and src/sars/html_out.py. This gives FEAT-002 a concrete checklist.
acceptance_criteria: The environment activates and `sars unpack` populates data/sars.
Baseline numbers for `sars all`, `python tools/template_audit.py`, and `pytest -q` are recorded verbatim in this feature's findings.
output/data/*.json, output/template_html/*, output/template_pdf/*, output/compare/TEMPLATE *.jpg are regenerated to reflect the current (pre-fix) state.
Findings confirm the extracted data carries per-cell recovered background colours, fonts and per-row pitch (so the defect is in rendering), with concrete example values from MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK.
Findings list the concrete shared-CSS/shared-chrome coupling points (DOC_CSS, TEMPLATE_CSS, styles.css, document_html, StylePool/TemplatePool) that FEAT-002 must remove.

findings.environment: venv at /projects/sandbox/mussannoni/.venv activates cleanly (python 3.11.15); `sars` on PATH at .venv/bin/sars. `sars unpack` populated data/sars from committed sars.zip. No packages installed (restricted network respected).

baseline_numbers.sars_all: 19/19 documents pass; mean text similarity 100.00% (conversion path text fidelity is intact and must NOT regress)
baseline_numbers.template_audit: no value lost 4/19; pagination matches 7/19; mean document similarity 97.61%. Per-doc LOSS examples this run: 'Mwanza Top 10 Schools' top_schools doc=91.80% pages 6->2; 'Mwanza f2 Mock Mobility 2026' mock_mobility doc=99.37% pages 6->9; 'Mwanza schools rank Overall' schools_rank doc=99.94% pages 6->6. (README quotes an older baseline of 6/19 & 97.26%; this run measured 4/19 & 97.61% - use THIS run as the before-reference.)

findings.regenerated_before_reference: Ran `sars data` (19 output/data/*.json), `sars template` (19 output/template_html/*.html + 19 output/template_pdf/*.pdf), and `python tools/compare.py --template` (19 output/compare/'TEMPLATE *.jpg'). These reflect the CURRENT (pre-fix) SHARED-CSS look and are the 'before' reference for FEAT-003. git status showed only 6 TEMPLATE compare JPGs as modified (MWANZA CC 10 BEST SCHOOLS, MWANZA CC SCHOOLS RANK, Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments, Mwanza Schools Rank For Governments (1), Mwanza Top 10 Schools, Mwanza schools rank Overall) - the rest regenerated byte-identical to committed. These regenerations were intentionally NOT committed as part of FEAT-001 (they are the before-baseline); FEAT-003 will regenerate + commit the after-fix versions.

data_carries_styles_confirmation.per_cell_styles_carry: rows[0].styles is a dict keyed by column index; each entry carries family (e.g. 'Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif'), size_pt (e.g. 4.0/4.2/7.0/3.6), bold, italic, color (e.g. '#000000', '#002060'), background hex, align (center/left), rotation. total_styles present (per-column list under key 'TOTAL' with same fields, sizes 4.2/7.0, backgrounds like '#dce6f1','#daeef3','#fabf8f','#d2fce6','#65ffab','#ffff00','#ffffcc'); total_pitch present ({'TOTAL': 9.037}).
data_carries_styles_confirmation.conclusion: The extracted DATA JSON currently carries rich per-cell PRESENTATION (fonts, sizes, weights, text colours, fill backgrounds, alignment, rotation) plus per-row pitch and total_styles/total_pitch. This PROVES two things: (a) the fidelity gap the user sees is in RENDERING, not extraction - the colours/geometry are available; and (b) per the authoritative 'DATA IS DATA NOT STYLES' steering, a later feature (FEAT-002) must STRIP these CellStyle/pitch/total_styles/total_pitch carriers OUT of the schema + JSON, moving all presentation into each report type's own self-contained template (competency colour computed deterministically from data, never stored).

shared_css_shared_chrome_coupling_points.checklist_summary: FEAT-002 must: (1) remove the shared DOC_CSS import/coupling from base.py and stop funnelling every report through document_html's single DOC_CSS+TEMPLATE_CSS <style> block; (2) delete the shared TEMPLATE_CSS font-size clamp; (3) eliminate the shared TemplatePool/StylePool wrapper so each report type owns its complete inline CSS; (4) stop html_out.write_document from writing/linking a single shared output/html/styles.css (inline per-document instead); (5) give each of the 6 templated renderer families its own self-contained structure + styling; while keeping `sars all` at 19/19 100.00%.

findings.notes: No source rendering files were changed in FEAT-001 (measurement only). ruff/black not run because no source was modified. The 'DATA IS DATA NOT STYLES' steering is recorded here as the driver for FEAT-002's schema/JSON strip; FEAT-001 only measured and confirmed the current data wrongly stores styles.
